article_notes: Case series of 5 dogs with Babesia negevi n. sp. (PCR and sequencing), Israel; 4 co-infected with Borrelia persica. Outcome (2 died, 3 survived) is given per dog in Table 1 only; the authors make no group comparison or test of any marker or host factor against outcome. Nothing extracted.

not_extracted.what: Per-dog clinical and laboratory values and co-infection status alongside outcome (Table 1, 5 dogs)
not_extracted.note: Individual case data only; no summary by outcome group and no test.
